items.title: 56712_Cootie Williams oral history interview
items.q: That's right. The hardest number Paul had to play, Duke would call.

ctx.x: Yeah. Just on that subject, because we were going to talk about how Duke did about that, so Duke was pretty canny when guys were pulling something, or when things happened to guys. I mean, when Paul would come on and he would be stoned, or something like that, or he'd be sitting up there sound asleep or something, Duke would throw his number at him, wouldn't he?
That's right. The hardest number Paul had to play, Duke would call.
